sloka: तद्भवान्यदि नो ह्यद्य दद्यादतुलविक्रम ।कृता भवेन्मम प्रीतिर्धुर्मश्चैवानुपालितः ।। ७.११.२५ ॥
transliteration: tadbhavānyadi no hyadya dadyādatulavikrama ।kṛtā bhavenmama prītirdhurmaścaivānupālitaḥ ।। 7.11.25 ॥

translations.english: O unequalled in valor, if you would indeed give it to us today, my satisfaction would be complete, and my duty would also be fulfilled.
